t: This is 27 and 28 Hyde Park Gate, in Kensington. It is a building you might walk past without noticing, but it matters for one reason. Sir Winston Churchill died here. He was Prime Minister from 1940 to 1945, through the Second World War, and again from 1951 to 1955. He sat in Parliament for most of the years between 1900 and 1964, and he led the Conservative Party from 1940 to 1955. He is remembered as a statesman, a soldier and a writer.
